problem_restatement: Determine whether the retired-from-v52 SP500/SPCX fresh-15-second pressure family has materially new source-native evidence while preserving prospective capture continuity and without reopening rejected threshold relaxations.

technical_incident.symptom: A bounded SP500 observer resume failed closed while summarizing its existing decision journal.
technical_incident.error: ValueError: MU shadow journal event type is invalid
technical_incident.root_cause: The shared runner correctly wrote route-specific SP500/SPCX event types, but the cumulative journal reader still required the MU-only event type.
technical_incident.unrecoverable_gap_policy: No historical decisions were backfilled. The durable cursor advanced prospectively and the missing interval remains an explicit evidence gap.
technical_incident.fix: Bind journal validation to the exact route event type derived from the selected symbol while retaining duplicate-event and no-authority checks.

validation.red_test: test_index_status_accepts_its_exact_route_journal_type failed on the hardcoded MU event type before implementation

sp500.interpretation: One small short winner is fully largest-winner dependent and does not establish edge.

spcx.interpretation: Both observed sides are adverse after costs; the long was operator-closed and remains valid realized route evidence but not a native exit-policy test.

prior_art_control.reason: Both measured source-native sides were negative after modeled friction at every tested horizon.
prior_art_control.reopen_condition: A later predeclared source-native window must materially expand independent observations and remain positive after exact costs, largest-winner removal, and side-specific analysis.

decision: Continue SP500/SPCX source-native observation only. Do not restore live authority, retune the route, remove the price-breakout requirement, or treat observer continuity as economic evidence.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Audit the first eligible v52 BTC or HYPE lifecycle immediately; it has higher decision value because v52 has no execution evidence. Keep the fixed-window MU transport finalizer and repaired index observers collecting in parallel without opening OOS or changing live authority.
minimum_evidence_to_update_index_diagnos: A predeclared later source-native window with complete boundary coverage, at least ten resolved lifecycles and at least three per side, exact fees/funding/slippage/latency/stops/exits, positive net and profit factor after largest-winner removal, no single lifecycle contributing over half of gross profit, and untouched forward confirmation.

confidence.index_route_profitability: low confidence in eventual edge; current evidence is adverse
confidence.observer_forward_update: low until materially more resolved source-native lifecycles exist

failure_modes: The restarted observer can stop again and create another unrecoverable prospective gap.
The shared REST pressure and live candle sources can remain internally consistent while differing from archive transport.
Sparse future winners can create false confidence unless largest-winner and side coverage rules are enforced.
Continuity repair can be misinterpreted as strategy repair even though no entry or exit economics changed.
falsifier: Revise the technical conclusion if an exact route journal still fails after the fix, duplicate or retroactive decisions appear, or SP500/SPCX identities cross-contaminate. Revise the economic disposition only when the predeclared minimum evidence is met or a distinct causal mechanism with its own development and untouched forward validation is introduced.
